selected_evidence.requirement: Primary loss simulated and standby promoted to writable primary without losing committed data

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary rejoins as standby of the new primary; surviving standby also follows new primary
selected_evidence.summary: node3 repointed to node2 and caught up; node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2 and started as standby.signal-based standby; final cluster-wide write (id 38) confirmed present on both node1 and node3
